title: Does overall strength influence clustering?
question: Do standardized raw stats cluster by strength / evolution stage rather than by role?
hypothesis: Yes: EDA showed every raw stat correlates 0.55-0.71 with BST.
methodology: Cluster all 1,025 Pokémon on standardized stats; compare the k=2 split with is_fully_evolved; repeat on fully evolved only.
interpretation: The strongest raw-stat split (k=2) matches evolved vs not-evolved for 92% of Pokémon. Removing unevolved Pokémon drops silhouette to 0.15-0.18 at every k. Raw-stat structure is mostly evolution stage and power level, not role.
limitations: Evolution stage is derived from PokéAPI evolves_from links; baby Pokémon count as stage 1.
